policy.introductionDate: Store YYYY-MM-DD. Small regional rollout differences are tolerated; when credible sources disagree, use the majority date rather than marking unresolved solely for a minor date discrepancy.
policy.introductionYear: Derived from introductionDate and not stored.
policy.testOnlyMachines: Exclude explicit test-only machine IDs from production backfill.
policy.gameTypeRule: Use A_AT/A_ART only when an actual real bonus coexists with AT/ART. Pseudo-bonus-only machines remain AT even if presented as A-type-like.

notes: All completed batches 01-11 now have explicit checkpoint files for interruption-resistant recovery.
Batch 11 resolved 10/10 production machines with no unresolved values.
SMART_SLOT/MEDAL is determined from source evidence, not machine ID prefix alone.
Introduction dates use majority/credible-source resolution for minor regional rollout differences.
L_STRIKE_THE_BLOOD_ZC is A_AT because it combines real bonus with AT; L_DRAGON_HANAHANA_SENKO_JP is A_TYPE; pseudo-bonus machines such as L_KING_PULSAR_SLCC remain AT.
